hero.subtitle: We build high-converting websites and automated lead systems that turn your traffic into paying clients, even while you're offline.

digitalStorefronts.heading: High-Conversion Digital Storefronts
digitalStorefronts.body: Your website is often the first thing a potential client sees. We build it fast and easy to use, so people trust you right away instead of clicking back to Google.

automatedBooking.heading: Automated Booking Systems
automatedBooking.body: No more emailing back and forth to find a time that works. We set up online booking so people can grab a slot on your calendar whenever it suits them, day or night.

leadRouting.heading: Zero-Leak Lead Routing
leadRouting.body: When someone fills out your form or sends a message, you get notified right away, and their details land straight in your CRM. Nobody falls through the cracks.

globalExpansion.heading: Global Market Expansion
globalExpansion.body: Want to reach customers in Spain, Catalonia, or Romania as well as English speakers? We build your site in all four languages from day one, so you're ready to sell wherever your customers are.

coreServices.heading: Stop Building Websites. Start Building Intelligent Systems.

items.title: High-Conversion Digital Storefronts
items.description: Outdated websites cost you clients before they even pick up the phone. We build fast, polished sites that earn trust the moment someone lands on them.

items.title: Automated Booking Systems
items.description: No more back-and-forth emails trying to find a time that works. We connect your site to scheduling tools so prospects can book a consultation straight into your calendar, any time of day.

items.title: Zero-Leak Lead Routing
items.description: A hot lead that waits too long goes cold. We connect your site to automated pipelines that text you the moment someone reaches out and log every inquiry straight into your CRM.

items.title: Global Market Expansion
items.description: We build your site in English, Spanish, Catalan, and Romanian, each one optimized for search, so you can reach local and international customers from day one.

operationalFlow.heading: How a Signal Becomes a Booked Customer

steps.label: Audit & Strategy
steps.detail: We start by reviewing what you have now: your current website, how bookings happen today, and where leads are slipping through the cracks. Then we map out exactly what needs to change.

steps.label: Build the Website
steps.detail: We design and build your new site to load fast and feel effortless to use. Pages appear almost instantly, so visitors stay instead of clicking away.

steps.label: Connect Your Calendar
steps.detail: We connect a booking tool to your website so people can grab time with you directly. They pick a slot that works for them, and it lands on your calendar automatically. No emails back and forth.

steps.label: Route Every Lead
steps.detail: Every form submission or booking triggers automated lead routing: you get a text message the moment it happens, and the details are saved for you automatically. You never have to go digging for a new lead.

steps.label: Handover & Launch
steps.detail: Once everything is tested and working the way it should, we hand you a finished system. You get a working website and a working process, ready to bring in clients from day one.

tiers.name: The Authority Foundation
tiers.description: A custom, fast-loading website built to help you stand out and start capturing leads right away.

tiers.name: The Smart Conversion Engine
tiers.description: A hands-off system for winning new clients: everything in the Foundation tier, plus automated calendar booking and instant lead routing.

tiers.name: Elite Market Dominance
tiers.description: A scalable, multi-language site built to help you compete in local and international markets at once.

bridge.heading: A beautiful website is just digital art if it never picks up the phone.
bridge.body: We build the art and engineer the infrastructure behind it: the systems that capture the lead, book the table, and get the review, automatically.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information PeakLogic Digital ("we", "us") collects through peaklogicdigital.com, why we collect it, and the choices you have. We collect as little as we can get away with.
privacy.collectFormText: When you submit the project inquiry form, we collect the name, email address, and message you provide. This is sent directly to us through Web3Forms, a third-party form-processing service, and used only to respond to your inquiry.
privacy.collectCookieText: If you make a choice in the cookie consent banner, we store that choice in your browser's local storage so we don't ask again. This is not sent to us or to any third party.
privacy.noAnalyticsPre: We do not run analytics, advertising, or tracking scripts on this site today. If that changes, it will only run after you explicitly opt in through the cookie consent banner, and this policy and our
privacy.noAnalyticsPost: will be updated to describe it.
privacy.thirdPartyPre: Contact form submissions are processed by
privacy.thirdPartyPost: , which delivers the submission to us and is bound by its own privacy policy. We don't control, and aren't responsible for, how Web3Forms itself handles data in transit.
privacy.retentionText: We keep inquiry details for as long as reasonably necessary to respond to you and, where a project goes ahead, for the duration of that engagement plus a reasonable period afterward for our own records. You can ask us to delete it sooner at any time.
privacy.rightsIntro: You can ask us at any time to:
rightsList: tell you what data we hold about you,
delete data we no longer need a reason to keep, and
stop using your data for a particular purpose.
privacy.rightsOutro: Send that request through the contact form on the homepage, including enough detail (like the email address you used) for us to find your record.
privacy.securityText: This site is served entirely over HTTPS. We don't operate our own database of visitor data: the only place inquiry details live is in the inbox they're delivered to and, briefly, in Web3Forms' systems while delivering them.
privacy.changesText: If we materially change what we collect or why, we'll update the date at the top of this page.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This site doesn't set any tracking or advertising cookies today. Here's exactly what it does store, and the choices you have.
cookies.useText: When you choose "Accept All", "Essential Only", or save preferences in the cookie banner, that choice is saved in your browser's local storage (not a cookie) purely so we don't ask again on your next visit. It never leaves your browser.
cookies.useOnly: That's the only thing this site stores in your browser right now. There is no analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking script running.
cookies.changeText: The "Accept All" and "Preferences" options in the banner exist so that if we add an analytics tool in the future (to understand traffic and improve the site), it will only run for visitors who've opted in, never by default. This page will be updated to name the tool and what it stores before that happens.
cookies.thirdPartyPre: Submitting the contact form sends your details to
cookies.thirdPartyPost: , a third-party form processor, which may set its own cookies as part of handling that request. That's governed by their policy, not this one.
cookies.controlText: You can clear your cookie consent choice at any time by clearing this site's local storage in your browser's settings, or by using a private/incognito window. Most browsers also let you block local storage and cookies entirely on a per-site basis.
cookies.changesText: If what we store changes, we'll update the date at the top of this page and, for anything non-essential, ask again through the banner.
